_what: The words the sign-in pages' script may show: failed, unavailable, not_sent, too_many and email_needed from the sign-in words the pages were drawn with; key_made is the key page's own; the rest are the connect pages' (consent, device). `scopes` says in plain words what each OAuth scope lets an AI do (a scope not listed is shown as its own name). `passkey_errors` says how a passkey step ended, by step (sign-in, make, any) and the error code Better Auth's client gives, from old Trillion's src/passkey-step.json: `already` means the device already holds a passkey, which is done.
failed: That did not work. Try again.
unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
not_sent: The code could not be sent just now, so none is on its way. Try again in a minute.
too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
email_needed: Type the email address you sign in with.
key_made: Your key is made and copied. Keep it now: it is shown only once.
code_wrong: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
code_expired: That code ran out. Start again on your device.

scopes.offline_access: Stay connected while you keep using it
scopes.records: Read and change what you keep in Trillion
scopes.records-read: Read what you keep in Trillion
scopes.account: See your account and your computers
scopes.vault: Use the logins and keys you keep

code_wrong_login: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
code_ran_out: That code ran out. Send a new one.
code_tries: Too many wrong tries for that code. Send a new one.
link_sent: A link is on its way to your email. Open it on the other device.
email_change_sent: Two links are on their way: one to your current address to approve this, then one to the new address.
passkey_unknown: The passkey step did not finish. Please try again, or choose "Email me a code".

AUTH_CANCELLED.said: No passkey on this device. Email me a code instead.

ERROR_PASSTHROUGH_SEE_CAUSE_PROPERTY.said: No passkey on this device. Email me a code instead.

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_PREVIOUSLY_REGISTERE.said: This device already has a passkey for Trillion.

ERROR_CEREMONY_ABORTED.said: The passkey step was closed or timed out before a passkey was made. Nothing changed. You can try again.
The passkey step stopped before it finished. Nothing changed. You can try again.

ERROR_INVALID_RP_ID.said: This browser refused a passkey for this address. Open the address you normally use for Trillion and try again.

ERROR_INVALID_DOMAIN.said: This browser refused a passkey for this address. Open the address you normally use for Trillion and try again.

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_NO_SUPPORTED_PUBKEYC.said: This browser cannot use passkeys. Choose "Email me a code" instead.

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_MISSING_DISCOVERABLE.said: This device cannot keep a passkey for Trillion. Try your phone, or choose "Email me a code".

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_MISSING_USER_VERIFIC.said: This device cannot keep a passkey for Trillion. Try your phone, or choose "Email me a code".

ERROR_PASSTHROUGH_SEE_CAUSE_PROPERTY.said: Your device refused the passkey. Passkeys live in your Apple ID or password manager: open its settings, sign in, then try again, or choose "Email me a code".

connected_held_by_wake: Only your scheduled job still uses this.
connected_reconnect_none: Open this AI and connect it again.
approve_unknown_call: This request is not one I can make for you.
approve_failed: That did not work. Try again.
approve_again: To keep your things safe, sign in once more, then this will finish.
